spec.main_purpose: A handheld calculator with a 4x4 key grid and a character LCD, powered by a battery.

payload.label: Looking for an existing open design

TI83x (CERN-OHL-S-2.0, weak fit, KiCad board only)
OpenRPNCalc (CERN-OHL-P-2.0, pcb-only fit, KiCad board only)
subwoofer-filter-calc (MIT, pcb-only fit, KiCad board only)

payload.reason: No archetype matched; generating a new KiCad board, case and firmware. Closest open design: AriCalculator (GPL-3.0, exact fit, KiCad + shell), compared only.

decision.reason: A 4x4 key grid needs 16 identical keycaps of standard 1u size, so the plain DSA 1u keycap fits best. The homing keycap is only for one or two marker keys, and the wider keycaps would not fit a uniform grid.
